what: New mode validates an existing perf-profile.json against all 4 acceptance criteria: (1) duration>=3600s, (2) >=3 endpoints with p50/p95/p99, (3) values in (0,30000)ms range, (4) percentile ordering p50<=p95<=p99. Exit 0=PASS, 1=FAIL.
